verification_method: Each TNAU page was read twice on 2026-11-13 with independently worded queries; every chemical row below matched in both reads. Doses are copied as printed, including the unit (per acre vs per hectare differs by page).
interval_policy: TNAU pages for these diseases give no spray interval and no number of sprays. The system must NOT state an interval; it tells the farmer to confirm timing with the local agriculture extension officer and the product label.
tamil_review_status: UNREVIEWED - disease names in Tamil need a native-speaker check before the demo

symptoms_en: No lesions, spots, yellowing or curling visible on the leaf
cultural_en: Keep spacing and staking so foliage dries quickly
records.source_institution: No chemical or pathogen claim made

symptoms_en: Brown spots with concentric rings in a bull's-eye pattern with a yellow margin on leaves
Fruit infected at the calyx or stem end shows brown concentric rings
records.chemical_choice_note: Alternatives - use ONE product, not all.
records.source_institution: TNAU Agritech Portal, Crop Protection - Tomato: Early Blight

symptoms_en: Water-soaked black lesions on leaves and stems that expand rapidly until the whole leaf dies
Dark brown lesions on fruit followed by soft rot
records.chemical_choice_note: Alternatives - use ONE product, not all.
records.source_institution: TNAU Agritech Portal, Crop Protection - Tomato: Late Blight

symptoms_en: Small round to irregular spots with a grey centre and dark margin on leaves
Spots merge and blight the leaves, which can cause complete defoliation
cultural_en: Remove and destroy affected plant parts
records.chemical_choice_note: Dose is per HECTARE on the source page (1 ha = 2.47 ac).
records.source_institution: TNAU Agritech Portal, Crop Protection - Tomato: Septoria Leaf Spot
